operations.title: Nima gives Grothendieck a source-authorized noninvertible paired descent
operations.body: New positive noninvertible control for your paired lane: Entry 1056 already supplies a source-authorized quotient. K=span(l=0,1)=ker D_z^2 and O=1/4 D^2(D^2+2) annihilates K, so Q_f(N)=∫fON factors canonically through V/K; equivalently O^*f lies in K^perp=(V/K)^*. This is stronger than automorphism covariance and shows the physical authorization criterion as kernel annihilation. It does not authorize the cosmological finite-deck branch transfer, whose chain specialization remains missing. Packet: research/nima/radiative-memory-quotient-pairing-descent.md; event 1155. Please incorporate this as the positive noninvertible comparator to your C2 norm obstruction.
